Extensions.File:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue' Start-Transcript -Path "$env:ProgramData\WinTweaks\firstlogon.log" -Append | Out-Null
# Region: Portugal Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId 193 Set-Culture pt-PT
# winget: wait for network (up to ~3 min) and for winget (up to ~10 min), then install for ($i = 0; $i -lt 90 -and -not (Test-Connection 1.1.1.1 -Count 1 -Quiet); $i++) { Start-Sleep 2 } $ids = @('Google.Chrome', 'Mozilla.Firefox', '7zip.7zip', 'Notepad++.Notepad++', 'Microsoft.VisualStudioCode', 'Microsoft.PowerToys', 'Valve.Steam', 'Discord.Discord', 'Microsoft.WindowsTerminal') for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60 -and -not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $i++) { Start-Sleep 10 } winget source update | Out-Null foreach ($id in $ids) { winget install --id $id -e --source winget --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements }
Stop-Transcript | Out-Null
